verdict.rationale: Supabase CLI explicitly supports running the full stack 'locally, on your machine or in a CI environment' (supabase-docs-21) and MCP/CLI tooling references dedicated migration primitives (`list_migrations`, `apply_migration` in supabase-supp-mcp-tool-groups), plus branching lets teams test schema changes before merging to production (supabase-docs-10/17/50). However, independent developer feedback flags this as a real weak spot — 'the local development & database migration story is Supabase's biggest weakness... I hate having to do migrations live in prod' (supabase-comm-7) — indicating the workflow works but is far from best-in-class or friction-free. Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of a version-controlled migration file workflow (e.g. `supabase migration new/up`) and independent confirmation that CI-based migration application works smoothly in production.
